name: Visa
description: Visa runs the world's largest card payments network. It does not issue cards, lend money, or take credit risk; banks issue the cards and lend, and Visa earns small fees every time a card is used. Fees are charged to those banks and merchant acquirers as a percentage of the dollars spent (service revenue), per transaction processed (data processing revenue), and on cross-border and currency-conversion payments (international transaction revenue). From that gross revenue it pays back client incentives to banks, which amounted to $15.8B of $55.8B in fiscal 2025. Growth follows consumer spending, cross-border travel, and adding value-added services such as fraud tools and Visa Direct money movement.

gics.note: Conventional GICS label from general knowledge (payment processors moved from Information Technology to Financials in 2023); not re-checked. SEC SIC code is 7389 (Services-Business Services, NEC), which shows how badly the old scheme fits.

hq.note: From general knowledge; cover page not re-read in this pass.

businessLines.name: Data processing
businessLines.shareBasis: of gross revenue before client incentives ($55,751M, computed)
businessLines.how: A fee for each transaction Visa authorizes, clears and settles; the number of processed transactions is the main driver.

businessLines.name: Service revenue
businessLines.shareBasis: of gross revenue before client incentives
businessLines.how: A percentage of the prior quarter's payments volume on Visa cards, paid by issuing banks; nominal payments volume grew 7% in FY2025.

businessLines.name: International transaction revenue
businessLines.shareBasis: of gross revenue before client incentives
businessLines.how: Fees on cross-border payments and currency conversion, so it depends on international travel and cross-border e-commerce; the highest-value fees per dollar.

businessLines.name: Other revenue
businessLines.shareBasis: of gross revenue before client incentives
businessLines.how: Value-added services (advisory, fraud and risk tools, some issuer solutions), licensing and other fees.

businessLines.name: Client incentives (contra revenue)
businessLines.how: Payments and rebates to banks and merchants to win and keep their volume; grows with payments volume. Gross revenue $55,751M less this equals net revenue $40,000M.

brands.name: Visa network
brands.share: Payments volume $13,433B, 311B transactions and 4,805M cards in calendar 2024 (10-K, from Nilson Report)

brands.name: Interlink, Plus, Cirrus
brands.note: Named in the 10-K; separate figures not extracted

brands.name: Visa Direct, Visa Intelligent Commerce, Visa as a Service
brands.note: Named in the 10-K; revenue not broken out
